lead.headline: Tuten ruled out; Taylor takes the seat
lead.deck: Jacksonville sat him after three missed practices. One swap before Sunday noon; Likely is cleared.
lead.body: Bad news first. Jacksonville ruled Bhayshul Tuten out for Sunday on Friday afternoon, after he missed every practice of the week. He is still in your RB slot and ESPN still shows his 18.7 — that number will be a zero. Start Jonathan Taylor in his place before 12:00 Sunday; Seth McGowan is out and Anthony Richardson starts for Indianapolis. Isaiah Likely carries no designation on the Giants' final report, so the Pitts fallback is retired. Boswell had 7 at Pittsburgh at 22:05Z, and the Steelers D/ST you dropped had 21. You trail JuiceJam by 32.
